WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    sp.zoneref AS site_code,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_usage_gap
  FROM scanprocessing AS sp
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
with_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    insurance_status,
    avg_remaining_storage,
    avg_cpu_gpu_usage_gap,
    avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER (), 0) AS storage_ratio
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  insurance_status,
  avg_remaining_storage,
  avg_cpu_gpu_usage_gap,
  storage_ratio
FROM with_ratios
WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) FROM group_averages) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
